d:
Rajasthan se Mame Khan ji ne kaha ‘padharo sa’
Hamne pyar se jawab Dia ‘aao ji’!!!
Aao sath men 7 ko!
Happy to share my first Rajasthani song , written and composed by me.
You will love the beautiful welcome song which joyfully touches the the notes of Raag Des, traversing through jaijaivanti and then making home in raag Saraswati
Aao Ji is daler mehndi's gift to Rajasthan. It’s a celebratory peppy dance song composed in raag Desh, Jaijaivanti and Saraswati fused with rajasthani rhythm, instrument and the signature daler mehndi style making it a must listen at wedding.
Credits
Song: Aao Ji
